task: put the cream cheese in the bowl

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the blue cream cheese block.
Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the black object on the white square base.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the blue cream cheese block from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese block on the table by closing the gripper fingers around it.
Grasp the blue cream cheese block on the table and lift it upward.
Lift the blue cream cheese block up off the table, moving it toward the bowl.
Carry the cream cheese horizontally across the table toward the bowl.
Lower the cream cheese down into the bowl.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and open the gripper.
Release the cream cheese into the bowl and retract the empty gripper upward.
Hold the open gripper stationary above the bowl containing the cream cheese.
